title: Peck: two strikes break a Shell
watch: Strike one (2) breaks the snail's Shell, strike two lands 2 more, and each strike gives the Birds behind +1 Attack.
note: The woodpecker is buffed to 4/5 so each strike deals 2, as in the scene. The snail is at a 1/8 override so it survives both strikes. Garden Snail has Shell 4, not the scene's 5. Yaffle isn't built.
